mapper.sql: id, disease_code AS code, disease_name AS name, disease_icd AS icd, disease_category AS category, active

where.if: AND ( disease_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR disease_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR disease_icd LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM disease
ORDER BY disease_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO disease (disease_code, disease_name, disease_icd, disease_category, active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{icd}, #{category}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE disease SET disease_code = #{draft.code}, disease_name = #{draft.name}, disease_icd = #{draft.icd}, disease_category = #{draft.category}, active = #{draft.active} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE disease SET active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
